scope: Training-compute and facility-energy estimator for accelerator clusters. Hardware values are reference presets; utilization, power draw, non-accelerator IT overhead and PUE remain explicit user assumptions.
freshness_policy: Review hardware presets on upstream NVIDIA specification changes and at least every 90 days. Methodology sources are reviewed when MFU, dense-training compute or PUE semantics materially change.

presets.note_es: 989 TFLOP/s usa el pico BF16 denso citado por NVIDIA; 700 W es el TDP máximo configurable del H100 SXM, no una medición de consumo medio.
presets.note_en: 989 TFLOP/s uses NVIDIA's cited dense BF16 peak; 700 W is the configurable H100 SXM maximum TDP, not a measured average power draw.

presets.note_es: El H200 SXM publica 1.979 TFLOP/s BF16 con sparsity; el preset usa la mitad como pico denso. El TDP máximo configurable publicado es 700 W.
presets.note_en: H200 SXM publishes 1,979 BF16 TFLOP/s with sparsity; this preset uses half as the dense peak. Published configurable maximum TDP is 700 W.

presets.note_es: HGX B200 publica 36 PFLOP/s FP16/BF16 densos para 8 GPU: 4,5 PFLOP/s por GPU. 1.000 W es el límite máximo documentado, no consumo medio.
presets.note_en: HGX B200 publishes 36 dense FP16/BF16 PFLOP/s across 8 GPUs: 4.5 PFLOP/s per GPU. 1,000 W is the documented maximum limit, not average draw.

presets.note_es: HGX B300 publica 36 PFLOP/s FP16/BF16 densos para 8 GPU: 4,5 PFLOP/s por GPU. La guía de despliegue muestra B300 SXM6 AC configurada a 1.100 W.
presets.note_en: HGX B300 publishes 36 dense FP16/BF16 PFLOP/s across 8 GPUs: 4.5 PFLOP/s per GPU. NVIDIA's deployment guide shows B300 SXM6 AC configured at 1,100 W.

nvidia-h100.title: H100 Tensor Core GPU product specifications and NVIDIA BF16 training guidance
nvidia-h100.notes: NVIDIA lists H100 SXM maximum TDP up to 700 W. Current NVIDIA training documentation uses 989 TFLOP/s/GPU as the maximum theoretical dense BF16 throughput for H100 when calculating MFU.

nvidia-h200.title: H200 Tensor Core GPU product specifications
nvidia-h200.notes: NVIDIA lists H200 SXM at 1,979 BF16 TFLOP/s with sparsity and up to 700 W configurable maximum TDP. The dense BF16 preset is therefore represented as half the sparsity-assisted figure.

hoffmann-2022.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
hoffmann-2022.notes: Primary reference for compute-optimal dense Transformer training and the approximate C≈6ND compute model used here as an editable workload approximation.

green-grid-pue.title: Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE)
green-grid-pue.notes: PUE is defined as total data-center energy divided by IT equipment energy. The estimator applies PUE after accelerator plus non-accelerator IT energy.

nvidia-b200.title: HGX B200 specifications and NVIDIA B200 power guidance
nvidia-b200.notes: HGX B200 publishes 36 dense FP16/BF16 PFLOP/s across 8 GPUs (4.5 PFLOP/s/GPU). NVIDIA documents B200 power limits up to 1,000 W.

nvidia-b300.title: HGX B300 specifications and DGX B300 deployment guidance
nvidia-b300.notes: HGX B300 publishes 36 dense FP16/BF16 PFLOP/s across 8 GPUs (4.5 PFLOP/s/GPU). Current NVIDIA deployment output shows B300 SXM6 AC configured at an 1,100 W cap.
